purpose: Compare already existing pilot and Round-1 observations to select observable dimensions and candidate invariants for the future formal 16-cell run.

evidence_streams.name: Cross-model pilot raw stream
evidence_streams.inventory: 11 final-answer files; Model B has no final answers; aggregate RUN_RECORD tracks only 4 C-model cells
evidence_streams.note: Use only for candidate-generation; not for stability claims.

comparison_dimensions.name: task outcome presence
comparison_dimensions.question: Does each model/sample produce an identifiable task decision or explicit failure?

comparison_dimensions.name: key-decision structure
comparison_dimensions.question: Does the output contain the decision type required by the sample (release/block, version choice, supported/rejected, anomaly list)?

comparison_dimensions.name: required-information presence
comparison_dimensions.question: Are the minimally needed facts/evidence items present?

comparison_dimensions.name: relation/conjunction formation
comparison_dimensions.question: Are separate facts combined into the relation needed by the task?

comparison_dimensions.name: representation compliance
comparison_dimensions.question: Is the required strict JSON contract satisfied without repair?

comparison_dimensions.name: explanation sensitivity
comparison_dimensions.question: Does adding explanation change decision/order/output viability?

comparison_dimensions.name: provenance/tool sensitivity
comparison_dimensions.question: Does process evidence affect immediate task behavior?

comparison_dimensions.name: uncertainty boundary
comparison_dimensions.question: Does the model explicitly preserve missing or uncertain evidence?

comparison_dimensions.name: degradation mode
comparison_dimensions.question: Is failure truncation, markdown wrapping, schema drift, repetition, or semantic contradiction?

observed_candidates.observation: All nondegenerate pilot outputs attempt a sample-specific decision or list; Round 1 formal arms likewise emitted decision/order/blocker JSON.
Valid A/C outputs usually attach source-grounded evidence or reason fields; degenerate/truncated outputs cannot support this reading.
Round 1 shows S1 continuation needs gamma baseline decision plus pair decisions; isolated M1.b or M2.b arms failed. S1 pilot conflict also shows relation interpretation can differ across models.

observed_candidates.candidate: Representation compliance is separable from semantic intent
observed_candidates.observation: Several outputs contain plausible task semantics while failing strict JSON because of truncation or markdown fencing.
Model A is strict-valid on short S1/S3 but truncated on longer S2/S4; Model C wraps output and has schema drift; Model D degenerates.

observed_candidates.candidate: Explanation/provenance are not obviously core for immediate continuation
observed_candidates.observation: Round 1 explanation-present failed once; hash/tool evidence variations showed no stable rescue. Pilot cannot confirm because isolation is absent.

formal_16_cell_observation_priorities: D2 normalized decision class, not wording;
D5 strict JSON and schema compliance;
explicit_nonclaims: no 846 atom is deleted, merged, retained, or mapped;
single-run differences are not causal findings.
